title: Signal: phpMyAdmin login interface disclosed
scope: One response whose body contains both the pma_username field and the phpMyAdmin name.
limitations: One response body. The rule reports the login page; it does not attempt a login and cannot show which database privileges would follow.

observation.body: <html><body><form method="post" action="index.php"><input name="pma_username" autocomplete="username"><input name="pma_password" type="password"></form><!-- phpMyAdmin 5.2.1 --></body></html>
<html><body><form method="post" action="index.php"><input name="" autocomplete="username"><input name="pma_password" type="password"></form><!--  5.2.1 --></body></html>

fpNotes: A deliberately published console is still reported; the finding is reachability, not a successful login.
